meta.name: nestjs-expert
meta.description: Creates and configures NestJS modules, controllers, services, DTOs, guards, and interceptors for enterprise-grade TypeScript backend applications. Use when building NestJS REST APIs or GraphQL services, implementing dependency injection, scaffolding modular architecture, adding JWT/Passport authentication, integrating TypeORM or Prisma, or working with .module.ts, .controller.ts, and .service.ts files. Invoke for guards, interceptors, pipes, validation, Swagger documentation, and unit/E2E testing in NestJS projects.

copy.tagline: 快速搭建 NestJS 后端模块与 API
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果正在用 NestJS 构建企业级后端服务
copy.tagline_en: Quickly scaffold NestJS backend modules and APIs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you are building enterprise-grade backend services with NestJS

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会帮你创建 NestJS 后端代码，包括模块、控制器、服务、DTO、守卫、拦截器等，并自动添加验证、Swagger 文档和单元测试。
howto.when: 当你要求构建 NestJS REST API 或 GraphQL 服务，或需要处理 .module.ts、.controller.ts、.service.ts 等文件时触发。

say.text: 帮我创建一个用户模块，包含 CRUD 接口和 Swagger 文档。
say.note: Claude 会生成模块、控制器、服务、DTO 和测试代码。

say.text: 给这个服务添加 JWT 认证守卫。
say.note: Claude 会创建或修改守卫和认证相关代码。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude helps you create NestJS backend code including modules, controllers, services, DTOs, guards, interceptors, with validation, Swagger docs, and unit tests.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to build NestJS REST APIs or GraphQL services, or when working with .module.ts, .controller.ts, .service.ts files.

say_en.text: Create a user module with CRUD endpoints and Swagger docs.
say_en.note: Claude will generate module, controller, service, DTOs, and tests.

say_en.text: Add JWT authentication guard to this service.
say_en.note: Claude will create or modify guard and auth code.
